commentary: Current rates show clear generational waterfall compression: B200 floor at $3.35/hr is only ~3.7x the A100 floor ($0.27/hr Vast.ai) vs historical 8-10x spreads, while H100 median ($2.50/hr) sits barely above twice the A100 median ($1.50/hr). The divergence in hyperscaler depreciation policy—Amazon shortening to 5 years while Meta extends to 5.5 and Oracle/Google hold at 6—signals deep uncertainty about GPU economic life in the Blackwell transition. CoreWeave's March 2026 investment-grade debt milestone pulled $8.5B of GPU collateral risk into pension/insurance portfolios just as CDS markets priced 50% default odds by July, creating a structural mismatch between credit ratings (A3) and market-implied survival that echoes pre-crisis CDO mispricing.
